verbosity.description: Verbosity level (-v). 0 for minimal, 1 for standard info, 2 for verbose output.

dump_pages.description: List of log page numbers to dump (0x02, 0x03, 0x05, 0x0d, 0x10). If empty or default, uses standard set. If specified, only these are inspected.

test_type.description: Self-test type to initiate (-T). Must be 'short' or 'long'. 'none' initiates no test.

targets.description: List of targets to operate on (adapters, channels, disks). Examples: 'a0', 'a0c0', 'a0c0t0'. Empty list applies to all.

run_health_check.description: Perform adapter health check (-H). Inspects logical/physical drives and BBU.

ignore_battery_issues.description: Do not treat battery problems as failures during health check (-B).

exclude_physical_disks.description: Do not report physical disks (-p). Reports only adapters and logical drives.
